text_en: But God remembered Noah and all the wild animals and all the domestic animals that were with him in the ark. And God made a wind blow over the earth, and the waters subsided;
text_cn: 天主想起了诺厄和同他在方舟内的一切野兽和牲畜，遂使风吹过大地，水渐渐退落；

text_en: the fountains of the deep and the windows of the heavens were closed, the rain from the heavens was restrained,
text_cn: 深渊的泉源和天上的水闸已关闭，雨也由天上停止降落，

text_en: and the waters gradually receded from the earth. At the end of one hundred fifty days the waters had abated;
text_cn: 于是水逐渐由地上退去；过了一百五十天，水就低落了。

text_en: and in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.
text_cn: 七月十七日，方舟停在阿辣辣特山上。

text_en: The waters continued to abate until the tenth month; in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains appeared.
text_cn: 洪水继续减退，直到十月；十月一日，许多山顶都露出来。

text_en: At the end of forty days Noah opened the window of the ark that he had made
text_cn: 过了四十天，诺厄开了在方舟上做的窗户，

text_en: and sent out the raven; and it went to and fro until the waters were dried up from the earth.
text_cn: 放了一只乌鸦；乌鸦飞去又飞回，直到地上的水都干了。

text_en: Then he sent out the dove from him, to see if the waters had subsided from the face of the ground;
text_cn: 诺厄等待了七天，又放出了一只鸽子，看看水是否已由地面退尽。

text_en: but the dove found no place to set its foot, and it returned to him to the ark, for the waters were still on the face of the whole earth. So he put out his hand and took it and brought it into the ark with him.
text_cn: 但是，因为全地面上还有水，鸽子找不着落脚的地方，遂飞回方舟；诺厄伸手将它接入方舟内。

text_en: He waited another seven days, and again he sent out the dove from the ark;
text_cn: 再等了七天，他由方舟中又放出一只鸽子，

text_en: and the dove came back to him in the evening, and there in its beak was a freshly plucked olive leaf; so Noah knew that the waters had subsided from the earth.
text_cn: 傍晚时，那只鸽子飞回他那里，看，嘴里衔着一根绿的橄榄树枝；诺厄于是知道，水已由地上退去。

text_en: Then he waited another seven days, and sent out the dove; and it did not return to him any more.
text_cn: 诺厄又等了七天再放出一只鸽子；这只鸽子没有回来。

text_en: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, on the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth; and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and saw that the face of the ground was drying.
text_cn: 诺厄六百零一岁，正月初一，地上的水都干了，诺厄就撤开方舟的顶观望，看见地面已干。

text_en: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.
text_cn: 二月二十七日，大地全干了。

text_en: Then God said to Noah,
text_cn: 天主于是吩咐诺厄说：

text_en: “Go out of the ark, you and your wife, and your sons and your sons’ wives with you.
text_cn: “你和你的妻子、儿子及儿媳，同你由方舟出来；

text_en: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh—birds and animals and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth—so that they may abound on the earth, and be fruitful and multiply on the earth. ”
text_cn: 所有同你在方舟内的有血肉的生物：飞禽、牲畜和各种地上的爬虫，你都带出来，叫他们在地上滋生，在地上生育繁殖。”

text_en: So Noah went out with his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives.
text_cn: 诺厄遂同他的儿子、妻子及儿媳出来；

text_en: And every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, everything that moves on the earth, went out of the ark by families.
text_cn: 所有的爬虫、飞禽和地上所有的动物，各依其类出了方舟。

text_en: Then Noah built an altar to the Lord , and took of every clean animal and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
text_cn: 诺厄给上主筑了一座祭坛，拿各种洁净的牲畜和洁净的飞禽，献在祭坛上，作为全燔祭。

text_en: And when the Lord smelled the pleasing odor, the Lord said in his heart, “I will never again curse the ground because of humankind, for the inclination of the human heart is evil from youth; nor will I ever again destroy every living creature as I have done.
text_cn: 上主闻到了馨香，心里说：“我再不为人的缘故咒骂大地，因为人心的思念从小就邪恶；我也再不照我所作的打击一切生物了，

text_en: As long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night, shall not cease. ”
text_cn: 只愿大地存在之日，稼穑（sè）寒暑，冬夏昼夜，循环不息。”
